name: Native-relative launch strength
hypothesis: Buy a launch breakout only when both token/native and token/USD returns exceed registered thresholds.
spec: Setup: A token rising only because its quote coin rises may not have independent momentum. Entry: Buy a launch breakout only when both token/native and token/USD returns exceed registered thresholds. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when native-relative momentum turns negative or the breakout fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
